title: Recurring Sludge Beast?
content: Drew this Sludge Beast I've been seeing in my dreams for the last few days. I dont think i got the skull proportions right but I'm not a biologist. Anyway it secretes corrosive poison and has a venomous stinger to inject the same stuff despite clearly being some sort of rodent or strange bird. It seemed to attempt to dissolve the location i was in, in every instance that i saw it. Not super aggressive but very territorial. About 10-15ft tall.
